name: web-fintech-hero-on-tablet-floating-in-clouds
title: Banking site on a huge tablet on a post amid clouds with pill tags across the top
whatItIs: A pale-blue sky with a giant tablet on a thin stand showing a cloud-backdrop site, with a hand holding a phone and floating stat cards. Outlined pill tags (Fintech, Dashboard, Behance, Mobile App, Landing Page, UI/UX, Case Study) sit across the top.
whatItMeans: Airy and clever; the tablet on a pole reads like a billboard in the sky.
techniques: Place the device in a sky scene matching the site's backdrop.
Line pill tags across the top as project metadata.
Overlap a phone and cards on the screen.
Stay in one light blue palette.

vocabulary.definition: A device shown like an outdoor sign.
A sky photo used as background.
A phone shown inside a tablet screen.
